lines.text: Many learners say: We arrived to the hotel late.
Better: We arrived at the hotel late.
At! We arrived at the hotel.

data.wrong: We arrived to the hotel late.
data.right: We arrived at the hotel late.

native.tip: 中文的“到”常对应 to，所以容易说 arrive to。英语 arrive 后面不用 to，到酒店、车站这样的地方用 at。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “We arrived to the hotel late.”😅 中文的“到”常对应 to，但英语 arrive 后面不用 to，到酒店这样的地方用 at：“We arrived at the hotel late.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“We arrived at the hotel late.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: After arrive, do not use to. For a place like a hotel, use at.
en.caption: Do you say “We arrived to the hotel late.” 😅 After arrive, do not use to. For a place like a hotel, use at: “We arrived at the hotel late.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
